title: MAINTENANCE AND WAREHOUSING OF WAR RESERVE MATERIEL (WRM)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-OO.411TH CSB.0411 AQ HQ     CONTRACT AUG
detail_text: This Sources Sought Notice is issued in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, specifically FAR 10.001(a)(2)(ii), for market research purposes only. The United States Air Force is seeking information from potential and eligible vendors capable of performing the maintenance and warehousing of War Reserve Materiel (WRM) and In-Use Assets located at various air bases across the Republic of Korea, pursuant to Attachment 1 ? DRAFT Performance Work Statement. This announcement is not a request for proposals and does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. THIS REQUIREMENT IS OPEN TO VENDORS THAT ARE LEGALLY AUTHORIZED TO CONDUCT BUSINESS IN THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA.
